title: Rage Against the Terminals
description: A furious red-haired woman with blood on her face and bared teeth points accusingly at a row of digital ordering kiosks. Behind the counter, a worker stands amid floating, dripping, colorful letters spelling variations of 'emotions' and 'options'.
prompt: A surreal painting of an enraged woman with wild curly red hair and blood splattered on her furious face, pointing directly at a row of self-service ordering kiosks. A fast food worker stands behind the counter. Large colorful 3D letters spelling EOT, EMOTIONS, OPTIONS drip from the top of the image. Chaotic paint drips and splatters throughout, dark satirical atmosphere, painterly style with visible brushwork.
